All rods, reels, and bait are provided. The captain and mate will assist you with set up and will find the best spots in the bay where the fish are biting. Things to Note Rods, reels, and bait are included Food and beverages are not included It is recommended to bring a jacket in the early summer and fall as temperatures on the water can be chillier than on shore.
